game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Market Square, a bustling cobbled market square: the royal scribe must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Memory Map: Place variable cards on a memory board so the wall banner reads the right value at run time.
theme: The Kingdom – Market Square: a bustling cobbled market square
core_gameplay_loop: In Market Square, repeat each round: Place variable cards on a memory board so the wall banner reads the right value at run time. Each round, thieves strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the y value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from thieves in Market Square: keep the y meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: y drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Memory Map
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Memory Map' (Week 1 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Market Square'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how y changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Market Square.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while y > 0.
